summary: IGC Pharma filed an 8-K reporting entry into securities purchase agreements with FirstFire Global Opportunities Fund and Vanquish Funding Group. The company issued two promissory notes totaling $584,960 aggregate principal ($346,910 and $238,050, each including an original issue discount), for aggregate proceeds of $514,000. The notes mature in 2027, carry 12% interest, and are convertible upon default into common stock at 75% of the lowest 10-day trading price, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap and a 19.99% exchange cap. This is a debt financing, not a special situation. Watch for potential dilution if default occurs.
